newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU vets Telia, Dutch PTT stake in Irish telecoms.
newsitem.headline: EU vets Telia, Dutch PTT stake in Irish telecoms.

text.p: The European Commission said on Monday it was reviewing the acquisition by Dutch PTT Telecom BV and Telia AB of Sweden of a joint stake in Irish state-owned telecommunications operator Telecom Eireann.

It said in a notice published in Official Journal C351 that the deal was submitted for clearance on November 14 under the merger regulation 4064/89. The Commission has one month from that date to clear the deal or start an in-depth probe.

The Irish parliament earlier this month allowed the sale of an initial 20-percent stake in Telecom Eireann to a consortium formed by KPN and Telia. The agreement foresees the acquisition by the same companies of an additional 15-percent shareholding in the next three years.

KPN and Telia are already partners in the Unisource joint venture formed with the Swiss PTT and Telefonica de Espana Unisource itself teamed up with AT&T Corp of the United States to provide advanced global telecoms services through their alliance called Uniworld.
